per_helper_reviews.reasoning: The plan SHA is passed to load_plan, which rechecks the exact release helper, approved tracker, baseline manifest, all556 selected solutions and all22 independent per-exercise approvals before returning. Preparation separately binds the selected prior audit. The copy list contains only1267 audited proof sources, five audited project files, the prior declaration extractor and31 planned site files; every selected source and site SHA is checked. Existing unexpected Lean/site assets are rejected before copying, and final flat sets must match the selected list. Existing outputs require identical bytes; new content-addressed objects are atomically created by review.put, set read-only, and hard-linked into the runtime. Only .lake/packages and .lake/build are runtime-only links to dependency caches; no archive or prior snapshot tree is copied. Inventory scanning is explicitly redirected to a temporary directory under the new release, then complete556-item/source-hash JSON is atomically published to source91-inventory. Old Source90 inventory and owner ledgers are not output targets. Preparation truthfully leaves native audit and rewritten HTML/proof correspondence pending.

Export requires a passed native record with actual exit zero, matching raw-log SHA and unchanged before/after inputs. It requires the exact selected-proof verifier command and runtime cwd, current SHA bindings for all eight mandatory project/preparation/plan/extractor inputs, the started-receipt SHA, matching started command/cwd and a verifier-report timestamp inside the execution interval. The pinned verifier performs fresh build and all-declaration axiom audit and fresh or explicitly eligible reused per-module kernel replay, validating source/dependency identity before and after execution. Export then checks passed report counts, all returned exit codes, all31 new source hashes, exact1267 prior proof hashes, allowed axiom dependencies for11472 entries, and current runtime source/project hashes. Every current check log and referenced reused-report SHA is preflighted before publication; evidence bytes are staged in memory and rechecked before immutable copies. The original native verification JSON is copied verbatim. Relocation changes only current output-file and copied reused-report locations; actual command/cwd and nested historical original-check ancestry remain intact. The explicit rebase-pending and coverage_complete false flags prevent automatic promotion of Source90 correspondence.

The expected release is loaded through the SHA/approval gate. A fresh named attempt performs actual git ls-remote, GH Pages-build, workflow-run and selected-run jobs requests and records their commands, working directory, exits and raw outputs. Every one of the31 planned site files is fetched via HTTPS with a unique commit/time query and no-cache header; a pass requires status200 and exact full-body SHA for every file. The remote main SHA, latest built Pages commit and completed successful Pages workflow head must all equal the requested40-hex commit. The jobs request is for that selected run and requires exactly three returned jobs, all completed successfully. Failed native requests or missing/mismatched assets/commits/jobs cannot yield success. Content and metadata attempts have separate immutable receipts; an interrupted attempt whose logs already exist must use a new attempt number. The helper retains raw observations and does not infer complete formal coverage.
